rationale: Drafted by Claude Code standing in for the composer agent. Y chose m1.13 because its quiet stretch (54.8-60.1 s) falls under s09, the grandmother line, in the English timeline. In Amharic the same meaning runs 3 s longer (E15): s09 starts at 56.5 s, so the silence would begin under the end of the toast line (s08) and the music would return halfway through s09. Anchoring the take's 54.8 s moment to the start of s09 keeps the silence under s09 in both languages: offset -0.008 s for English, +1.75 s for Amharic.
